tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Content area, cards, dialogs, popovers, plain toasts.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Body text on background, sidebar and window.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, icons at rest, timestamps, counts.

tokens.name: window
tokens.usage: Top bar and icon rail behind the panel (transparent over the window material on macOS and Windows 11).

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: Page sidebars (mail folders, settings, Wit conversations); light fills of cards inside panels and kbd.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Dividers inside panels, and the outlines of cards, dialogs and popovers (shadcn --border).

tokens.name: outline
tokens.usage: The faint edge of a panel over the window material: the foreground at 5%, lighter than border.

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: Outlines of inputs, selects, checkboxes, radios, the switch track and outline buttons (shadcn --input).

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring at 50% opacity, and a hovered or dragged divider (shadcn --ring).

tokens.name: divider-hover
tokens.usage: A draggable divider hovered or dragged (the sidebar's edge): a step darker than border.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Default buttons, a switch that is on, checked boxes.

tokens.name: primary-text
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary.

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: A hovered row, ghost button or secondary button; badges; tab list track.

tokens.name: sidebar-selected
tokens.usage: The selected row of a sidebar, at regular weight; its icon is muted until hovered.

tokens.name: rail-selected
tokens.usage: The selected icon of the rail: a tint of the foreground over the window material (4%; dark: white 10%).

tokens.name: hover-tint
tokens.usage: A hovered rail icon or ghost button: a tint of the foreground over the window material (4%; dark: white 8%); over white it equals hover.

tokens.name: unread
tokens.usage: The dot beside unread mail in the list.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Status dot for a healthy account; success icons.

tokens.name: success-bg
tokens.usage: Success toast background.

tokens.name: success-border
tokens.usage: Success toast outline.

tokens.name: success-text
tokens.usage: Success toast text and icon.

tokens.name: attention
tokens.usage: Status dot asking for a look (re-login needed).

tokens.name: warning-bg
tokens.usage: Warning toast and alert background.

tokens.name: warning-border
tokens.usage: Warning toast and alert outline.

tokens.name: warning-text
tokens.usage: Warning toast and alert text and icon.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions, error text, invalid input outline.

tokens.name: danger-bg
tokens.usage: Danger alert and error toast background; a destructive ghost button on hover.

tokens.name: danger-border
tokens.usage: Error toast outline.

tokens.name: danger-text
tokens.usage: Error toast text and icon.

tokens.name: ins-bg
tokens.usage: Inserted words in a Wit revision.

tokens.name: ins-text
tokens.usage: Text of inserted words.

tokens.name: del-bg
tokens.usage: Deleted words in a Wit revision.

tokens.name: del-text
tokens.usage: Text of deleted words.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: Search matches, drawn as <mark>: Tailwind yellow-200 behind the matched word, text stays foreground (neutral-950 in both themes), radius-xs.

families.sans: Geist, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", system-ui, sans-serif

tokens.name: space-0-5
tokens.usage: Gap between sidebar rows.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tight gaps; the base unit (Space(n) = 4n).

tokens.name: space-1-5
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap in small controls.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Panel inset from the window edge; row padding.

tokens.name: space-2-5
tokens.usage: Card and list-row padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Sidebar padding; card gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Page padding on small panes; dialog gaps.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page content padding; dialog padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Row and control height (default button).

radius.note: Tailwind v4's rounded-* steps; the app's theme.RadiusScale (Xs … X4l, Full).

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Hairline details; not used yet.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, kbd, checkboxes.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, selects, small buttons, tabs.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Buttons, sidebar and list rows, popovers, the rail buttons.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: The sidebar + content panel, cards.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Dialogs, sheets, toasts, the Wit input box.

tokens.name: radius-3xl
tokens.usage: Not used yet.

tokens.name: radius-4xl
tokens.usage: Not used yet.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Dots, switches, avatars, round icon buttons.

tokens.name: shadow-xs
tokens.usage: The page panel and small logo tiles (Tailwind v4 shadow-xs). Not on controls: buttons, inputs and selects have no shadow, as in shadcn Nova.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Cards, the selected tab (Tailwind v4 shadow-sm).

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Popovers, select lists (Tailwind v4 shadow-md).

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs, sheets, toasts (Tailwind v4 shadow-lg).

tokens.name: shadow-xl
tokens.usage: Anything above dialogs (Tailwind v4 shadow-xl).

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: A floating input box (the Wit input): the 1px ring is its outline, so it has no border. Dark: rgba(255,255,255,0.2) 0 0 1px 0 inset; the app draws that as a white 12% hairline, as mygo has no inset shadow.

meta.source: github.com/godwit-email/godwit internal/theme (Tailwind v4 palette, shadcn neutral)
